text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Application Cp − exact Cp at each panel centre; α = 4°. All samples in the last 2% of chord are shown.
The exact edge is at zero distance and is not a panel-centre sample. Mesh refinement moves the sampling locations.
Finite-panel discrepancies are real error: Kutta equality at the mathematical edge does not remove this near-edge error.

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42566b

g.text: Only the raw sample positions and errors are connected. These exact-flow checks do not establish viscous or experimental accuracy.
